entry_points.text: Complete offlining: on success finalize node, discard empty-zone caches, stop tasks, announce and detach; on failure undo isolation and reenable caches and handling.
Remove interval via locked serialized or unchecked fatal form, both needing all blocks offline; range form sweeps offline under exclusion then removes or restores.
Prepare and confirm exclusive use: mark covering blocks isolated after unmovable check, then confirm marks persisted with no pinned pages.
Tear down node when no frames spanned and no blocks or CPUs attached, marking offline and unregistering; stop reclaim task exactly once with repeat tolerance.
Boot computes batch once and observes online and offline at fixed priority; sysfs creates memory object; fault-injection and loglevel parsers arm testing.

exports.text: Zone per-CPU cache control with stats drain and isolated-range finalization: suspend, restore and discard caches, fold diffs, count newly offlined frames.
Pageblock isolation and acceptance: isolate intervals, verify isolation, classify movability, relocate free pages, accept deferred blocks.
Hotplug offline and physical removal with node teardown, plus aligned range removal that offlines then removes all blocks.
Mempool lifecycle and generic use: init and node creation, exit and destroy, resize guarantee, single and bulk alloc and free.
Early committed-memory batching and device map setup: global batch with recompute routine and device zone initializer.

hazards.text: Wrong mark order or early rebuild exposes empty node; finalize, unchecked removal and partial altmaps are fatal or warned; range input rejects null, empty, unaligned or zero length, treats already offline as success and removal as infallible after full offline.

Straddling compound fails and restores; wrong allocator mode, unaccepted skipping, missing huge-page wait, diagnostics under lock, driver-held offline refs and poisoned handling cause false busy or missed isolation.
Pool misuse is a programming error: nonpositive resize, reserve overflow, slab cache with constructor, cleared alloc; corruption reports identity, size, occupancy, address window and stack.

Placement identities: normal and movable zones, general and normal node marks, offline and cancel events, last-memory and cancel, no-node, isolate and movable types with offline and allocator modes, largest extents and page size.
Stats and sizing identities: zone counts, tail flag, busy, exists and invalid errors; batch starts 32, strict divides by 256 versus 4, capped at max signed int.
Boot guards: oversized percent or page overflow warns yet records, missing usable zone is fatal, device init without map or with non-device zone warns and aborts.

invariants.text: Offline success orders watermark recompute, normal then general mark clear, memoryless mark, fallback rebuild and conditional cache discard and task stop; failure unwinds isolation, announcements and caches in reverse.

Suspend zeroes thresholds and drains under mutex; restore reinstalls saved values then unlocks; discard drains stats on all online CPUs to boot singletons; drain folds nonzero diffs and clears sources.

Finalize walks under lock after marking offline, skips poisoned and already offline, detaches isolated buddies advancing by size and reports new only; accept removes largest block, accounts, unlocks for arch work and returns to buddy tail.

Isolation aligns outward to block bounds with boundary-aware edges, marks once if contained and unwinds all on interior failure; single-block mark accepts deferred content, rejects already isolated, scans only overlap and relocates free pages.

Unmovable scan stays in one block with allocator-mode handling and extent skipping; reserved and oversized block, movable-zone and empty skip, poisoned and offline only in offline mode; verify waits for huge-page release then checks marks and frames under lock.

Removal needs all blocks offline, detaches firmware then devices and arch under guard with all-or-none altmaps, releases registry and region and tries node offline; node skips while frames, blocks or CPUs remain; per-block offline infers mode and reonline restores touched only.

Init sets spin state and queue, records callbacks and minimum, keeps one slot, prefills reserve and frees partial state on failure; shrink discards outside lock then lowers minimum, grow installs larger array unless raced then fills.

Alloc tries constrained fresh creation, then reserve, then fuller retry with injection forcing reserve; reserve sleeps briefly outside lock when allowed else returns; free refills below guarantee, wakes only if sleepers, with alloc-free ordering.

With debug and no sanitizer, pushes fill extent with pattern and pops validate it by backend size with temporary mapping on high memory, reporting mismatch with identity and stack; sanitizer poison applies symmetrically.

Boot keeps zone bounds and movable starts; core option takes percent or bytes; totals sum intervals; anchor is highest nonempty non-movable zone; per-node starts use hotplug, mirror or spread-rebalance, aligned and cleared at end; extents clamp, subtract absent and sum totals.

Memmap clamps to zones, inits movable and fills gaps reserved; pageblock init allows override and yields; device pages reserve and link map with managed zero counts; batch bounds by CPU with strict fraction; pageflags shifts verified disjoint.

locks.text: Batch mutex held from suspend through restore; zone lock in IRQ-safe mode covers isolate marking, finalize walk, deferred accept and verify scan, with accept released before arch work and diagnostics after unlock.

Node task pointer guarded by per-node lock with exactly-once stop; device hotplug lock serializes locked removal and range sweep through rollback, with memory hotplug guard around device and arch work.
Per-pool IRQ-saving spinlock guards occupancy, guarantee and slots for push, pop, shrink, grow and refill, never across backing calls or wait; bulk paths add ordering around locked sections.

state_machines.text: Node memory goes populated to memoryless by clearing normal then general marks before fallback rebuild; offline and node-removal announcements pair success with cancel on failure.

Blocks normal to isolated on mark, stay through verify and finalize, return on failure and reject concurrent marks; caches active to suspended to restored or discarded; deferred blocks unaccepted to accepted via tail.
Removal firmware to device and arch to registry and region to node teardown, direct or altmap by all-or-none; range removal offlines all with remembered modes then removes or rolls back touched only.
Movable starts pick one mode: hotplug lowest, mirror lowest non-mirrored above low memory, else normalized core amounts spread evenly with rebalance.

structs.text: Zone holds lock, start frame, present and populated counts, per-CPU pagesets and stats with boot singletons, saved thresholds and isolate count; per-CPU stats hold zone and optional NUMA diffs cleared on drain.
Memory block carries node id, state, start section and optional altmap; node carries zone array with present counts and reclaim task pointer.
Pool reserve is a stack indexed by occupancy with capacity checks and debug transitions; opaque context means byte length, cache pointer sized via accessor, or page order per backend.
Boot globals expose max frame, page array base, direct-map top and memory object; frame-to-node cache keeps last interval and node.
